verdict.rationale: Lever's recruitment-analytics docs claim customizable dashboards, trend/rolling-average tracking, and benchmarking across 26,000 talent teams, which supports funnel and conversion visibility, but no evidence explicitly names stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, or offer-accept rate breakdowns per role/team. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of these specific metrics, per-role/team breakdown examples, and independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboard accuracy.
